press_references.value: Cross-Border Payments Company Announced a New Payment Collection Method for Businesses & Fintechs

product_launches.description: Neema launched Neema Request-to-Pay, a new account-to-account payment collection method that lets businesses and fintechs receive funds directly from customers’ bank accounts via its cross-border payments platform.

press_references.value: Neema Unveils Dynamic Routing, Ensuring Seamless Transaction Flow and Optimization of Every Cross-Border Transaction for FX Rates, Efficiency and Speed

product_launches.description: Neema has launched Dynamic Routing, a new technology designed to optimize cross-border transactions for FX rates, efficiency, and speed. This product enables real-time analysis of multiple transaction routes, improving success rates and cost-effectiveness for global payments.

press_references.value: Neema’s Dynamic Routing® Helps Financial Institutions Cut Payout Costs by Up to 24%

product_launches.description: Neema highlights the one-year milestone of its Dynamic Routing® technology, a patented routing engine that optimizes cross-border payout routes for financial institutions, improving success rates and costs.

overview_description.description: With millions of banks and financial institutions and dozens of local payment methods accessible through our network, Neema specializes in providing tailored B2B solutions. We invite financial institutions, NGOs, and other businesses to benefit from our global payment solutions and seamlessly send money to near infinite country-currency-payment method combinations.
